explanation: The structure that was built around Jerusalem to protect the city from enemies and invasions.
An enemy of Nehemiah and the Jews, who tried to prevent the rebuilding of the wall in Jerusalem.
Another enemy of Nehemiah and the Jews, who worked with Sanballat to stop the rebuilding of the wall.
The effort and activities undertaken by Nehemiah and the Jews to rebuild the wall in Jerusalem.
Obstacles and challenges that Nehemiah and the Jews faced during the rebuilding of the wall.
Communication with God, where Nehemiah and the Jews asked for help and guidance during the rebuilding.
The security measures put into place by Nehemiah and the Jews to protect the workers and the project from hostile attacks.
The solidarity and cooperation among Nehemiah and the Jews to complete the rebuilding of the wall despite the opposition they faced.
